faqs.q: What are Bijur Delimon Air-Oil Panels, Splitters and System Parts?
faqs.a: Air-oil panels and components for building or servicing air-oil systems, plus service parts for the HyperFormance chain pin system and the Spin-Rev spray unit. It is listed in 27 part numbers, from IH-BD-20311-8 to IH-BD-B1936.

Quote the full part number, or the machine and lubrication points, and we confirm the item before quoting.

faqs.q: Which part numbers and versions does Bijur Delimon Air-Oil Panels, Splitters and System Parts cover?
faqs.a: 27 listed part numbers — reservoirs 2 to 4 L; maximum pressure 150 psi (10 bar). The size table gives each part number's data. The size table lists each part number with its own published data, and Indus part numbers are IH-BD- followed by the Bijur Delimon item number.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right Air-Oil Panels, Splitters and System Parts for my machine?
faqs.a: For Bijur Delimon Air-Oil Panels, Splitters and System Parts, Air-oil suits high-speed bearings and spindles that need a small, continuous oil feed with cooling air — far less oil than an oil bath or oil mist, and no mist in the workshop. Start from the number of points, the oil grade and the shot each point needs (0.01 to 0.30 cc per cycle), then the air supply: it must be clean and dry, so plan a filter-regulator. Add an oil streak sensor where a lost feed would mean a bearing failure.

faqs.a: Bijur Delimon Air-Oil Panels, Splitters and System Parts are listed with: max pressure 150 psi (10 bar); reservoir 2 to 4 L; operating temperature -18°C-60°C. These are the maker's published figures for the range; the size table gives each part number's own data, so confirm the one you need.
